extracted.name: Triple-berry Quick Muffin (from All-purpose Baking Mix)
extracted.description: 10 net carbs Recipe from Wheat Belly Cook Book **This was surprisingly not bad! It's not grainy/gritty in texture and is a little sweet. **Follow the recipe for All-purpose Baking Mix that I have to make this.
ingredient_lines: 1/4 c frozen or fresh mixed berries
instruction_lines: In med. bowl, combine baking mix, cinnamon, sweetener and salt.
Whisk in egg, milk and butter.
Transfer mixture to large mug or 10 oz ramekin.
Place berries carefully in cup on top of batter. This will help keep them from sinking to the bottom of the muffin when cooking.
Microwave on high power 2 min. or until toothpick inserted comes out clean. If using fresh berries, microwave 1-1/2min. Allow to cool 5 min.
